title: Hearty Tunisian Oyster Mushroom Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Tunisian dish featuring oyster mushrooms in a rich and spicy tagine sauce, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is paleo-friendly and has a nice balance of mustardy and aerated flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the oyster mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the tagine and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot over cauliflower rice or paleo-friendly bread.
